column1: Whisk all the marinade ingredients together in a large bowl. Set aside 1/2 cup for basting.
Put the chicken in a large resealable bag, pour in the remaining marinade, seal, and massage to coat.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 24 hours; 4–6 hours is ideal.
Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates.
Let excess marinade drip off the chicken and grill 5–6 minutes per side, basting occasionally with the reserved marinade, until it reaches 165°F (74°C).
Tent with foil and rest at least 5 minutes before serving.
Optional: boil any leftover reserved marinade and simmer until slightly thickened to use as a sauce.
